Class GuiXMLReader

java.lang.Object
common.xml.GuiXMLReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
GuiXMLConstants
public class GuiXMLReader extends Object implements GuiXMLConstants

Title: Gui XML Reader

Description: Reads JModel GUI specific information from an XML file. This class provides methods for model load.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 27-lug-2005 Time: 11.04.13

    • parseXML

      public static void parseXML(Document xml, CommonModel model)
      Parses given Gui XML Document to reconstruct all gui related stuff. This method is designed to be called ONLY when all simulation's data has already been put into data structure (as will never create new user classes or stations)
      Parameters:
      xml - document to be parsed
      model - data model to be elaborated
